title: M7.P5: Handle unavailable hardware readings in system information
body:
## Qualification reconciliation — 2026-10-11

Corrected assembled image1a02664844 is now qualified: installed rocknix-info exits0 without stderr, positive clean/retained startup records and eight reviewed640×480 INFORMATION frames; four save/state hashes and selected configuration survive the real19→20 update. See [corrected clean/upgrade qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-pixelelated-replacement-20).

The earlier remaining-work statements below are historical; the acceptance checklist is reconciled to the evidence above. No owner device/cloud action or publication occurred.

## Pre-build qualification finding

The maintainer: “Let's fix any caps we discover before we generate a new build. Since we know that this will be the next build, we'll feel better about doing some of the cloud. If we're finding issues along the way, we should resolve them now.”

Installed replacement19 rocknix-info emits missing CPU/GPU sysfs and arithmetic errors, blank MHz values, and exits127 when the optional quirk glob has no matches. The prior #530 baseline-script.json shows the same behavior, so this predates semantic identity changes. Identity rows still render correctly; there is no new cloud regression.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Run the actual script with absent, malformed and valid synthetic optional readings, preserving real conversions and information labels; then exercise the exact script on the disposable VM and retain reviewed INFORMATION/CPU frames with updated canonical references. No owner hardware or cloud is needed.

Already written: information collection assumed optional device interfaces always existed. Fix this shared error handling without inventing sensor values, changing units, or suppressing real quirk failures.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Original script reproduces missing-hardware errors/unsuccessful status; corrected script has a successful quiet default, no blank or fabricated frequency values, and preserved valid CPU/GPU/temperature conversions.
- [x] Optional quirk discovery skips absent/nonexecutable entries, executes valid quirks and retains failures from an executed quirk.
- [x] Source-bound VM INFORMATION/CPU frames and canonical references cover the affected missing-data behavior; meaningful positive/negative controls and local review are retained.
- [x] The corrected script is included and verified in the next GENERIC_X64 qualification before H700 and SM8550 builds.

Parent #344; discovered while completing #530/#532 exact-image proof. Replacement19 remains accepted evidence for its own source, not the corrected bytes.

Source and reviewed VM proof delivered in 3fcff2e1e2: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-optional-hardware contains 13 original/corrected controls and three reviewed frames. The commit wording accidentally triggered automatic closure; issue reopened because corrected assembled-image qualification remains open. Original CI failure is retained.

Maintainer clarification: “any caps we…” meant “any gaps”. The request is to resolve gaps, not change capitalization.
